name: 4-Deck Waveform Height
author: MiuxH
summary: Adjust the native four-deck waveform height from original to nearly touching.
description: Independent community mod for EP147 2.00. Adds Enable and eleven 0-100% waveform-height steps in the native four-deck view. Uses a firmware-specific code hook on the native component paint dispatcher; preserves native grid heights and restores original geometry when disabled. Settings persist through the core configuration service. No network access, direct file writes or audio changes. User-tested in the emulator and on a real XDJ-AZ with AZ-MODS 1.2.5.
